verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5080 is consumer GPU hardware, not a web service or SaaS product, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style HTTP API spec is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product shipping such a spec; the probe of developer.nvidia.com OpenAPI paths returned 404 on every candidate, so the exception does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
